newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER RISES, VOLUME FALLS.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER RISES, VOLUME FALLS.

text.p: Turnover rose to 281,000 denars at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian stock exchange from 260,100 denars at the previous session a week ago as two companies traded, the exchange said.
A total of 20 Commercial Bank Skopje shares traded on the third floor at 550 denars, down 250 from last Tuesday and below par of 1,000 denars.
Usie sold 200 stocks at 1,350 denars, unchanged from the previous close and below par of 2,665 denars.
Traded volume was 323 shares last Tuesday.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades on Tuesday and Thursday.
